decisions: Move artist resolution and viewer/entitlement computation out of `+page.server.ts` into a new `src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/+layout.server.ts` (current `+page.server.ts:8` 404 lookup and `:13-14`/`:19-21`/`:32-37` isOwner/isSubscriber logic) so it runs once per artist and is NOT re-run when only `[view]` changes. Write `src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/layout.server.spec.ts` first, modeled on the event-object-literal + `vi.mock` pattern in `src/routes/api/artist/[id]/subscription/server.spec.ts:10-18` (mocking `$lib/db/queries` and `$lib/server/entitlement`), covering: throws 404 when `ArtistService.getArtistBySlug` resolves null; `viewer.isOwner`/`isSubscribed` true when `locals.user.id === artist.userId`; `EntitlementService.isSubscriberOf` is called and `canSubscribe` is true for a logged-in non-owner non-subscriber. Run `yarn test:unit -- --run src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/layout.server.spec.ts` and confirm it fails (module doesn't exist) before writing the implementation.

Only after that spec is red, implement `+layout.server.ts` moving the logic from `+page.server.ts:8-14` and `:19-37` unchanged in behavior (return `{ artist, viewer, isSubscriber }`, since per-view loads need the raw `isSubscriber` boolean via `await parent()`), and confirm the test goes green.

Write `src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/page.server.spec.ts` first for the reduced root load: call `load({ params: { slug: 'foo' } } as any)` and assert it throws an object with `status: 307` and `location: '/artist/foo/feed'` (SvelteKit's `redirect()` throws a plain object with those two fields — no mocking needed, this is a pure unit test of the load function). Run `yarn test:unit -- --run src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/page.server.spec.ts` and confirm it fails against the current DB-backed implementation (current body at `+page.server.ts:7-67`) before rewriting it. This closes the gap where the root entry point's redirect had no automated coverage.

Implement the reduced `src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/+page.server.ts` as a one-line redirect load — `export const load: PageServerLoad = ({ params }) => { throw redirect(307, \`/artist/${params.slug}/feed\`); };` — replacing the entire current body (`+page.server.ts:7-67`). This corrects an earlier draft of this decision that had a stray closing brace (`.../feed}`), which the new `page.server.spec.ts` now catches: the spec's exact-string assertion on `location` fails immediately if that typo is reintroduced. Confirm the spec goes green.

Write `src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/[view]/actions.server.spec.ts` first for the `votePoll` action, reusing the `evt()`-style event-object-literal + `vi.mock` pattern from `src/routes/api/artist/[id]/subscription/server.spec.ts:10-18` (mocking `$lib/db/services/ContentService`'s `PostPollService`). Cover, unchanged from the current behavior at `+page.server.ts:75-99`: 401 when `locals.user` is missing; 400 when `pollId` or `optionId` form fields are missing/blank; success path calls `PostPollService.vote({ pollId, optionId, userId })` and returns `{ success: true }`; failure path (`result.ok === false`) returns `fail(400, { error: result.reason })`. Run `yarn test:unit -- --run src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/[view]/actions.server.spec.ts` and confirm it fails (module doesn't exist yet) before creating the file. This directly addresses the gap where the prior plan flagged votePoll as needing to move but never scheduled the move or its test.

Implement `src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/[view]/+page.server.ts` exporting only `actions = { votePoll: ... }`, moving the body of `+page.server.ts:69-99` (the `getString` helper plus the `votePoll` action) verbatim — no behavior change, only relocation. Deliberately no `load` export here: view data comes from the new universal `[view]/+page.ts` (cache-aware) instead, so adding a server load to this route would force a server round-trip on every tab click and defeat the client-side view cache. Because SvelteKit resolves a form's default action against the current page's own route, and every `[view]` path now serves this same actions file, poll voting keeps working from any tab (feed, posts, etc.) without the `+page.svelte` form markup needing to change. Confirm the new actions spec goes green.

Write `src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/view.spec.ts` first for a new pure helper `resolveView(view: string | undefined): ViewId` (in a new `src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/view.ts` exporting `ARTIST_VIEWS`, the 6 ids) covering: known ids pass through unchanged; `undefined` and an unknown string both resolve to `'feed'`. Run `yarn test:unit -- --run src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/view.spec.ts` and confirm red before writing `view.ts`. Reused by both `[view]/+page.ts` (redirect invalid segments to feed) and `+page.svelte` (derive `activeTab` from the URL).

Write `src/lib/stores/artist-view-cache.spec.ts` first for a new plain module `src/lib/stores/artist-view-cache.ts` exporting `get(key: string)`/`set(key: string, value: unknown)` backed by a module-level `Map`. Not a `.svelte.ts` rune store like `src/lib/stores/chat.svelte.ts:22-58` — nothing in the template reads it reactively, it's only consulted synchronously inside a `load` function — so keep it a plain, framework-agnostic module that runs in the `server` vitest project (`vite.config.ts:120-121` glob is `src/**/*.{test,spec}.{js,ts}` excluding `*.svelte.{test,spec}`, no browser instance needed). Cases: `set` then `get` with the same key returns the exact stored value; `get` on a missing key returns `undefined`; a second `set` on the same key overwrites the first. Run and confirm red before implementing.

Write `src/routes/api/artist/[slug]/[view]/server.spec.ts` first, modeled on `src/routes/api/artist/[id]/subscription/server.spec.ts:1-38`'s event-object + `vi.mock` style (and `+server.ts:6-24`'s plain-handler shape, though this new endpoint is a public GET with no auth/CSRF guard). Cases: GET with `view=music` calls `TrackService.getTracksByArtist` (`src/lib/db/queries.ts:377`) and `AlbumService.getAlbumsByArtist` (`src/lib/db/queries.ts:919`) but NOT `ArtistPublicContentService.getArtistContent`; GET with `view=photos`/`videos`/`feed`/`posts` calls `getArtistContent` (`src/lib/db/services/ContentService.ts:1114`) and, for feed/posts, also the track/album services; GET with `view=shop` or an unrecognized view calls neither and returns 200 with an empty payload; GET 404s when `ArtistService.getArtistBySlug` resolves null (this endpoint re-resolves the artist itself since it's fetched independently of the SvelteKit load chain, unlike the page loads which get it from the layout). Run and confirm red.

Implement the endpoint reusing `ArtistPublicContentService.getArtistContent`, `TrackService.getTracksByArtist`, `AlbumService.getAlbumsByArtist`, and `EntitlementService.isSubscriberOf` (`src/lib/server/entitlement/EntitlementService.ts:9`) completely unchanged — only which calls fire per `params.view` changes (via `resolveView`/`ARTIST_VIEWS` from `view.ts`). `getArtistContent` itself stays monolithic (out of scope) but is simply not invoked for `music`/`shop`.

Write `src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/[view]/page.spec.ts` first for the new `[view]/+page.ts` universal load (no existing `+page.ts` exists anywhere under `src/routes` to model), mocking `$lib/stores/artist-view-cache`, `$app/environment`'s `browser`, and `event.fetch`. Cases: (a) `browser: true` + cache miss → calls `event.fetch('/api/artist/<slug>/<view>')`, awaits/parses the JSON, stores the resolved value in the cache under `` `${slug}:${view}` ``, and returns it; (b) `browser: true` + cache hit → returns the cached value synchronously without calling `event.fetch` at all — the actual 'don't refetch an already-loaded view' behavior; (c) `browser: false` (SSR) → always calls `event.fetch` and never reads/writes the cache, even with a same-keyed entry present — a server-side module-level `Map` is shared mutable state across every concurrent user's request in the same Node process, so consulting it during SSR would leak one visitor's content into another's response; this case must be shown to fail if the `browser` check is removed; (d) an invalid `params.view` triggers `redirect(307, '/artist/<slug>/feed')` via `resolveView`, checked before any fetch/cache logic. Run and confirm red.

Implement `[view]/+page.ts` per the above. Returning the awaited resolved value (rather than the un-awaited promise the current `+page.server.ts:62-65` streams) is a disclosed tradeoff: SvelteKit's promise-streaming only applies to server load nodes, never a universal (`+page.ts`) load's returned promises — confirmed in Svelte's own `{#await}` runtime (`node_modules/svelte/src/internal/client/dom/blocks/await.js:70-124` for the promise path vs. `:139-142` for the non-promise path, where a non-thenable value is set and rendered via `:then` immediately with no microtask delay, both SSR and CSR). So an already-resolved value renders real content immediately on the SSR pass — satisfying direct-URL-access with data loaded — in exchange for losing today's server-streamed-skeleton-then-fill behavior.

Flag as an accepted, standard cost: per `node_modules/@sveltejs/kit/src/runtime/client/client.js:3029-3050`, `load_node` runs for every route node including universal ones during `_hydrate`, so a universal `+page.ts` load re-runs once more in the browser right after the SSR'd page finishes hydrating — the first view shown on a fresh full page load incurs one extra `event.fetch` post-hydration (cache is empty in a fresh JS context). Subsequent tab clicks within that session are genuinely free of refetch via the cache — this only affects the very first view per full page load, not tab switching, so it doesn't undermine the no-refetch requirement.

Move `+page.svelte` to `src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/[view]/+page.svelte`. Switch data access from `const { artist, viewer, tracks, albums, content } = $derived(page.data as PageData)` (current `+page.svelte:15`, reading `$app/state`) to the standard props pattern already used at `src/routes/(app)/+page.svelte:5` (`let { data }: { data: PageData } = $props();`). Keep `Tabs` (`src/lib/ui/Tabs.svelte`) unchanged — its internal `click()` at `Tabs.svelte:67-70` reassigns the bound `activeTab` directly, so bind a local `activeTab = $state(...)` (not a `$derived`, not a valid two-way bind target). Replace the bare `bind:activeTab` at `+page.svelte:85` with `bind:activeTab onTabChange`, where `onTabChange` calls `goto(`/artist/${artist.slug}/${tab.id}`, { noScroll: true, keepFocus: true })` — every click is a real `goto()` (shallow-routing via `pushState` was rejected: `node_modules/@sveltejs/kit/src/runtime/client/client.js:2504-2542` shows `pushState` only updates `page.state`/the browser history URL, not SvelteKit's reactive `page.url`/`page.params`, so it can't drive `activeTab` derivation, and the `+page.ts` cache already makes a same-view `goto()` a zero-network no-op). Add an `$effect` that resyncs local `activeTab` from `resolveView(page.params.view)` (using `page` from `$app/state`) whenever it changes, replacing the plain `let activeTab = $state(tabs[0])` at `+page.svelte:31` — covers back/forward and direct links.

Do not call `invalidateAll()` anywhere in the new navigation path — `src/lib/client/subscription.ts:16` is the existing (and here inapplicable) pattern for the separate subscribe/unsubscribe flow; it must not be copied for tab navigation.

Write `src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/[view]/page.svelte.spec.ts` first, modeled on `src/routes/page.svelte.spec.ts:1-13` (`vitest-browser-svelte`'s `render()` + `@vitest/browser/context`'s `page.getByRole`). Mock `$app/navigation` (`vi.mock('$app/navigation', () => ({ goto: vi.fn() }))`, the same technique as `src/lib/studio/music/uploadController.svelte.spec.ts:11`) and `$app/state` (a `page` object exposing `.params.view`). Cases: rendering with `page.params.view = 'music'` derives `activeTab` as the Music tab (asserted via the active tab button's class/aria state); clicking the Feed tab button calls the mocked `goto` with `/artist/<slug>/feed` and never calls `invalidateAll`. Run `yarn test:unit -- --run src/routes/(app)/artist/[slug]/[view]/page.svelte.spec.ts` and confirm it fails before the `+page.svelte` move/rewrite, then confirm green after.

Retype the shared view components' props: `ArtistFeed.svelte:2,10,13` (and `ArtistPosts`, `ArtistPhotos`, `ArtistVideos`, `ArtistTracks`, `ArtistAlbums`) currently import prop types via `PageData` from `'../$types'`, generated from the old `[slug]`-level `+page.server.ts`. Since that route no longer produces `tracks`/`albums`/`content`, repoint these prop types to the named service types directly — `PublicArtistContent` (`src/lib/db/services/ContentService.ts:144`) for `content`, and the inferred return types of `TrackService.getTracksByArtist`/`AlbumService.getAlbumsByArtist` for `tracks`/`albums`. No functional change: `content`/`tracks`/`albums` remain either a pending promise or an already-resolved value, and `{#await content}` (`ArtistFeed.svelte:13`) already handles both per the verified Svelte runtime behavior above.

Manual verification (beyond the automated specs above, which now cover the root redirect and votePoll move as well as the view/cache/navigation logic): run `yarn dev`, click through all 6 tabs confirming the URL updates with no full reload/flash and a revisited tab shows no network activity in devtools; hit `/artist/<slug>/music` and `/artist/<slug>/posts` directly to confirm real SSR content renders; hit `/artist/<slug>/bogus` to confirm redirect to `feed`; submit a poll vote from a non-feed tab to confirm the action still resolves against `[view]/+page.server.ts`.
